name: Sonal Yadav
bio: Sonal Yadav is an Associate Professor in Economics and Public Policy Area, Ahmedabad University, Ahmedabad. She did her BA (Hons) and MA (Economics) with a specialization in Economics of Human Resources from the M.S.University, Baroda. Her M.Phil. research focused on Labour Market Segmentation in India. She has a PhD degree in Economics from Gujarat University, Ahmedabad. Her doctoral thesis examines the impact of economic reforms on industrial labour concerning small-scale engineering industries in Gujarat. Her PhD thesis title was "Impact of Economic Reforms on Industrial Labour- A Study of Small Scale Engineering Industries of Gujarat".

Professor Yadav started her teaching career in 1995. She worked as a Part-time Lecturer at Arts and Commerce College, Kapadwanj, B.V.D. Arts and Commerce College, Ahmedabad, and S.M. Patel Institute of Commerce, before joining H.L. Institute of Commerce in 2001, which later became a constituent of Ahmedabad University.

She has presented several research papers at National and International conferences. She has also published research papers in peer-reviewed national and international journals. Her primary research areas include Labour Economics, Issues of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), Mental Health and Gender Studies. She has also worked on a research project examining the impact of demonetization on the rural economy. Another research project of hers was on studying secondary school dropouts in the Ahmedabad district and “Student-Led Mental Well-being Prevention Interventions.” Recently, she submitted a final report to ICSSR. It was a major research project funded by ICSSR titled "Digital Labour Platforms in India: Understanding Precarity and Empowerment".

She is a life member of the Indian Economic Association (IEA), Indian Society of Labour Economics (ISLE), Gujarat Economic Association (GEA), Indian Association for Canadian Studies, and WILPF (Women's International League for Peace and Freedom) India chapter.

Professor Yadav is a Certified Prevention of Sexual Harassment (PoSH) Trainner. She conducts trainning sessions in various organisations to spread awareness about the PoSH Act 2013. Recently, she is appointed as Gender Expert, Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) Committee, GIFT IFI, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India.

sections.title: Research
paragraphs: RESEARCH PROJECTS
Received ICSSR major research project on “Digital Labour Platforms in India: Understanding Precarity and Empowerment” (January 2024-January 2026)
Successfully completed a research project titled “Student-Led Mental well-being Prevention Interventions” (Academic Year 2022-23)

Successfully completed the research project on " A Study of Secondary School Drop-outs: Reasons and Way Forward" funded by the University Research Board, Ahmedabad University in the academic year 2018-19.

Successfully completed a Research project titled "Demonetisation and Its Impact on Rural Economy" funded by the University Research Board, Ahmedabad University, in the academic year 2017-18. The working paper on "Impact of Demonetisation Through The Lens of Financial Inclusion in Rural Locals" can be accessed on https://ahduni.edu.in/research-working-paper/impact-of-demonetization-through-the-lens-of-financial-inclusion-in-rural-locals
